title: Settings screen
description: A profile header, sections of settings rows with one control each, a picker, an edit sheet with fields and a confirmed sign-out

quality.sections: A label-default-s section title over a panel (background="surface" border radius="l" paddingX="16") of rows, a Line between rows
quality.rows: One control per row, paddingY="12"; Switch reverse with its own label and description puts the control on the right
quality.editing: Editing happens in a Dialog sheet: fields in a Column gap="16" inside KeyboardAvoidingView, Cancel and Save in the footer
quality.danger: Sign out last, Button variant="secondary" tone="danger" fillWidth, confirmed in a Dialog
